instructions: ** Players can interact with the grate when it is bubbling to prevent an add from spawning. To this extent, ranged DPS can position themselves to be in range to attack, while still able to quickly interact with the grates when they bubble. Should adds spawn, try to keep their numbers down to prevent the tank from being overwhelmed. If a caster is targeted by the adds, they should run to the tank so that the tank can remove hate while staying by the boss.

The Aqua Balls that apply Slime can overlap to inflict Slime on nearby players. Players can therefore have more than 1 Slime debuff at a time. Avoid standing too close to other players; otherwise, the healer might need to remove Slime several times from a single party member before the Tail Screw attack is used. As long as no one has the debuff, the highest priority after that is keeping the tank's health high.
So in short, the healer's priorities are as follows:

Karlabos will drop Aqua Balls on players to apply a damage-over-time (DoT) debuff called File:Slime icon1.png Slime. Remove the DoT ASAP with Esuna. He will also target the highest-enmity party member with Prey. A few seconds later, Karlabos will stun the player holding the Prey effect. Prey can be passed to other players by physically running into them, resulting in a stun on that player instead. His next attack is Tail Screw, which he will use on a player that is not the tank. Tail Screw will bring the player to 1% of their HP, but will not kill them; however, the player will die if they have the Slime debuff on them. Tail Screw can be stunned; if possible, the tank should pass Prey to a nearby DPS before being stunned so they are able to stun Tail Screw immediately after.

The Aqua Balls that apply Slime can overlap to inflict Slime on nearby players. Players can therefore have more than 1 Slime debuff at a time. Avoid standing too close to other players; otherwise, the healer might need to remove Slime several times from a single party member before the Tail Screw attack is used. As long as no one has the debuff, the highest priority after that is keeping the tank's health high.
*Remove Slime debuff from everyone before Tail Screw attack > Keep tank health up > Keep party members' health up.
Players should gather in the center of the boss room for the 3rd set and the 4th set (final set) of adds then AoE them down. Use caster Limit Break on the 3rd set if needed.
The Ink Jet AoE attacks are not worth dodging. Healers should remove the Blind they cause before resuming normal healing activities.

Players should pick an Arm that is near the boss and is in a corner then kill the Arm. Then ranged DPS should hide near the hole in a position that is out of reach of other Arms and DPS the head of Kraken.

Wandil has several AoE abilities (one of which is unavoidable) which add a stacking debuff called File:Frozen icon1.png Frozen to all players affected. ("Ice has begun forming on gear. A stack of 4 will result in Deep Freeze.") Once this debuff reaches 4 stacks, the player is afflicted with Deep Freeze for a short duration. Periodically he will summon Frost Bombs which will self-destruct after some time or when they get low health. These should be killed to avoid additional damage and more stacks of the debuff. Healers should keep an eye on their stack count and try to top up the party's health before they're stunned.
*Ecliptic Bite: very high damage tank buster
After Lunar Cry, Fenrir will jump onto the tank for moderate damage with no telegraph.
Lleva Lightning Orb a uno de los tres pilares.
Usa Flame Orb para descongelar y crear agua.
Cura Unholy y vigila a jugadores congelados.
Conserva movilidad para resolver tu color.
Sal del grupo si te sigue un orbe de hielo.
Guía el orbe al objetivo correcto sin cruzar la alianza.
Mantén a Scylla estable, lejos de la ruta de orbes.
No evapores el charco antes del cast.
Permanece en agua hasta que Ancient Flare golpee.
Precura al grupo y entra en agua.
Interrumpe tu cast y entra en agua.
Abandona el hitbox a tiempo.
No dejes AoE sobre el charco seguro.
Mueve al jefe solo si bloquea acceso al agua.
A, B y C ocupan su plataforma cargada.
Después elimina adds y repite Ancient Flare con agua.
Cubre daño grupal al salir de la protección.
Mantén daño en adds y reserva movimiento para el próximo charco.
No abandones la plataforma antes de resolver.
Ayuda con adds desde tu sector.
Recoge los adds de la segunda fase.

Elemental balls - Random DPS and healers will be marked to be followed by balls of elemental energy. Lightning balls appear purple, ice balls appear blue, and flame balls appear red. You will have to deal with this mechanic throughout the fight.
Unholy - raid-wide AoE. Damage as a whole is fairly heavy, which can be problematic if the healers are undergeared.

Daybreak - Scylla casts Daybreak, which petrifies everyone in the room for 30 seconds. If your lightning pillars are not fully charged by this point, everyone is petrified, which can lead to a wipe (but can be salvaged if you have a healer LB3).

Ice ball - Trails a target and will freeze that target after a set duration of time. This is unavoidable and cannot be stopped. What you can and should do is make sure that you are not standing in one of the puddles left behind when a frozen target is thawed, as everyone in the vicinity of the puddle will be frozen as well, an important consideration for melee. Thaws after 30 seconds.

Again, tanks can group up all enemies so players can defeat them with AoE attacks. After defeating them, a Green Dragon will land, damaging and knocking back nearby players (Touchdown). After defeating it, three Doga's Clones will spawn and must be defeated, followed by three Unei's Clones.
Párate en la zona sombreada para cortar la línea.
Mata el Wright mientras el enlace está interceptado.
Cura al jugador aturdido que intercepta.
Evita Aura bajo tus pies mientras cambias de objetivo.
Cambia al Wright conectado más cercano.
Intercepta enlaces lejanos y destruye adds.
Mantén a Glasya en el centro; recoge constructos peligrosos.
Conecta los Squires y elimínalos.
Activa los tres saltadores antes de Deathstream.
Prepara curación para Deathstream.
Observa el reflejo antes de lanzar burst.
No golpees al jefe mientras refleje daño.
Prioriza nodos y Squires de tu sector.
Agrupa Squires sin girar al jefe sobre el grupo.
A izquierda, B abajo, C derecha.
Avanza solo en una dirección y regresa al centro tras limpiar.
Mantén al grupo unido durante los saltos.
No te quedes casteando cuando la plataforma sea bombardeada.
No saltes antes de que muera el add.
Ataca el siguiente objetivo al aterrizar.
Lidera el recorrido de tu alianza.

After a minute into the fight, Glasya Labolas will summon Clockwork Wrights. These can be killed easily, but form a line to Glasya Labolas and either draw power from him or give him power. A DPS or healer needs to stand in the small shaded area next to the add and intercept the line. This stuns the player but allows the Clockwork Wright to be killed. Duty Finder - Alliance Roulette groups will usually be able to kill Glasya Labolas at this point. A period-accurate PoV video demonstrates the following mechanics:

This fight occurs on a big, circular central platform surrounded on all sides by smaller platforms connected by one-way launch pads and is a two phase fight interrupted by an intermission in the middle. Tanks should position Glasya Labolas in the center of the arena.
Mata #33, #66 y #99 antes de que apliquen Silence o Pacification.
No te coloques frente al cleave Coloatura.
Limpia con Esuna el debuff de bomba.
Evita Thundaga superpuestos y usa instantáneos al cambiar.
Ataca adds desde flanco/espalda.
Stun y daño rápido a adds en las esquinas.
Mantén a Amon al centro y toma Kum Kum.
Haz que el orbe de Mini toque a Kum Kum.
Como sapo, usa Flame Breath para liberar congelados, no todos los bloques.
Mantén vivos a congelados y sapos perseguidos.
No derritas el último hielo disponible.
Mata Kichiknebiks que persiguen sapos.
Guía el orbe y elimina serpientes.
Sujeta Kum Kum en la ruta del orbe.
Alinea el bloque entre Amon y tu personaje.
No derritas el hielo durante el cast.
No intentes curar atravesando la mecánica; escóndete.
Cancela tu cast y confirma cobertura.
Sal del hitbox del jefe para que el bloque funcione.
Comparte espacio sin salir de la línea de protección.
Abandona el frente y usa cobertura.
His frontal cleave is called Coloatura and is extremely damaging, so no one except for the main tank should be in front of him.

He will also spawn purple orbs (Dimensional Compression) which will tether to a player and cast Mini on them if it hits, at this time strong adds called Kum Kum will spawn which should be grabbed by the off tanks. They can be shrunk by the orbs making them much easier to kill. If not successful at shrinking anyone the orbs will eventually fade on their own.
Ocupa un círculo vacío antes de que detone.
Evita superponer AoE personales.
Distribúyete para cubrir círculos sin abandonar alcance.
Muévete temprano hacia un círculo lejano.
Toma los círculos dentro o cerca del hitbox.
Prioriza círculos exteriores.
Mantén a Xande centrado y ocupa un círculo cercano.
Cada alianza elimina su attractor del borde.
Todos convergen en el attractor gigante del centro.
Aprovecha la pausa para recuperar al grupo.
Reserva burst para el attractor central.
No cambies al centro antes de matar el exterior.
Ataca el objetivo de tu alianza en cuanto aparece.
Agrupa adds secundarios y ayuda al centro.
Cada alianza comparte su círculo sin superponerlo con otros.
Tras resolver, entra en Null Gravity y luego dispersa.
Cura tras el stack antes de Quaga.
Después de Quaga, sal de AoE bajo jugadores.
Entra en la zona flotante aunque pierdas uptime.
No superpongas el stack de otra alianza.
Mantén al jefe accesible sin sacar stacks de sus grupos.

Intermission 2 - Same as intermission 1, except at 40% health. Only each group now has to deal with two small meteor attractors instead of just one. Not too difficult. Since no damage is going out in entire intermission, healers should catch up on healing and join in the damage.

Xande should be tanked in the center of the arena. He has the standard "don't stand in this" mechanics, including a targeted AoE which deals about 2k damage. While not dangerous, a DPS can potentially be one-shotted if two are overlapping each other and the DPS is still standing in them. He also has Knuckle Press, which is centered on him, and deals moderate damage with a severe knockback. Melee must watch out for this.
Controla el número del debuff: normalmente come una fruta al llegar a 2 stacks.
No uses otra fruta mientras tengas Morbid Meal; tarda 20 segundos en desaparecer.
Gold Lung no se limpia con Esuna; cada jugador debe usar una fruta.
Si la interacción se interrumpe por golpes, usa un stun sobre Locksmith antes de comer.
Locksmith is the first boss of The Aurum Vale - this gigantic Ochu has several high damage mechanics that will test the capabilities of the parties' healers.
* Hundred Lashings is a melee attack that deals moderate to high amount of damage.
====Tank Mechanics====
In order to click on the Morbol Fruit to remove the debuff stacks, tanks may have to stun Locksmith to avoid being interrupted.
Sal del cono frontal y no te quedes delante del boss.
Vuelve a la espalda cuando termine.
Esquiva por un costado y conserva la orientación del boss.
Aléjate del boss: el círculo cercano hace daño enorme.
Swipe, Swing y Eye of the Beholder pueden detenerse con stun.
Leg Sweep puede cancelar el cast; si no, sal.
Low Blow puede cancelar el cast.
Colócate cerca del boss o directamente detrás: son las zonas seguras.
No permanezcas en el arco exterior.
Esuna puede limpiar Electrocution si alguien falla.
All non-tank players should stay away from the front of the boss at all times- Coincounter has 2 types of "100-Tonze" cleaves:
Mantente detrás del morbol para evitar Bad Breath.
Come una Morbol Fruit a 2–3 stacks de Burrs, o inmediatamente si Bad Breath te llena de debuffs.
La fruta también elimina los múltiples debuffs de Bad Breath; no dependas solo de Esuna.
Orienta Bad Breath hacia una pared y usa una fruta sin girar el boss al grupo.
Cambia inmediatamente a las cinco frutas y destrúyelas antes de que abran.
Si nacen seedlings, elimínalos antes de que acumulen más Burrs.
Daño de área o Limit Break ranged/caster puede limpiar la tanda rápidamente.
Ayuda con la fruta más alejada.
Mantén al boss lejos del grupo de frutas para no cubrirlas con Bad Breath.

:* If the healer gets hit by Bad Breath, it can very quickly lead to a wipe. Healers and ranged DPS should stay far away from the boss. Esuna can be used to remove the Bad Breath debuffs, but this will only remove one status effect at a time, and if the healer is the one that was hit, the Silence effect will prevent using Esuna anyway. Players should use the Morbol Fruit to remove all the effects at once if they are hit with Bad Breath.

At half HP, Miser's Mistress will spawn 5 strange Morbol Fruits that must be destroyed immediately. Use a physical ranged or caster limit break if needed. Any fruits that hatch will turn into Morbol Seedlings that will add Burr debuff stacks with every attack. If any seedlings hatch, this could easily wipe the group.

Miser's Mistress is the final boss of The Aurum Vale. This Morbol boss has powerful frontal AoE attacks and should be faced away from all non-tank players. The debuffs from Bad Breath could be deadly.

*Resounding Screech: Untargettable clones of Einhander appear small untargetable Einhanders will appear, holding ceruleum tanks, which they will drop onto the platform. Keep your distance from the glowing red tanks to avoid the large circle attacks around them. After the first tanks explode, more may begin to glow, so be sure to avoid those as well.
**Mark XLT Quick-firing cannon: At the same time, Einhander will fire a line Aoe that causes at least two of the tanks to glow and explode.

* Upon killing this add, it will perform a small conal AoE that inflicts a stacking File:Scale flakes icon1.png Scale Flakes debuff, which allows the boss to become targetable and attack the person (preferably the tank) with the highest amount of stacks. It also increases damage taken.
* The boss regularly does small frontal cleaves toward the main target, dealing moderate damage. Tanks should face the boss away from the party.
Quédate en la espalda del dragón en todo momento.
Si gira, corrige tu posición antes de volver a atacar.
Burns de Lion's Breath es limpiable si alguien queda delante.
Oriéntalo hacia una pared y esquiva Swinge lateralmente sin barrer al grupo.
:Rake is an instant melee attack that deals a small amount of damage.

Chudo-Yudo is the first boss of the dungeon. He has powerful frontal breath attacks that all players besides the tank should avoid. One strategy is to only have the tank stand in front of Chudo-Yudo, rest of the party members stand behind the dragon at all times. By staying out of his breath attacks, the fight should be fairly easy.
*All non-tanks stand behind the dragon at all times.
Identifica el carril sin tornado y colócate allí.
Mantente fuera de Sonic Storm mientras esperas.
No tapes la lectura de los carriles con movimientos innecesarios del boss.
Ponte delante de uno que todavía esté quieto.
Cuando pase la primera pareja, cruza detrás de ella antes de que avance la segunda.
Usa un cast corto entre movimientos; la segunda pareja no espera.
:Spiked Tail is this boss's tankbuster. All other party members should steer clear of the tank.
Muévete inmediatamente a uno de los dos lados no iluminados.
Cerca del final habrá dos tandas de Sheet of Ice: no las apiles con otros jugadores.
Frostbite hace daño en el tiempo; estabiliza a quien falle.
La franja puede matar: moverse tiene prioridad absoluta.
Sal del centro antes de que aterrice.
Cuando esté en tierra, vuelve a su espalda y evita Frost Breath.
Recoge al dragón tras el aterrizaje y oriéntalo lejos del grupo.

Throughout the fight, Isgebind will take flight and a strip about a third of the room in width will glow with a icy blue light. After a few seconds Isegebind will fly over the area and use its frost breath. Players caught in the area will take damage and the debuff Frostbite for moderate damage over time. Squishier players (e.g. healers and ranged DPS) can be killed instantly by this, so be careful. Stand near the middle and be prepared to run toward one side. However, when Isegebind returns to the arena, players should move out of the center to avoid being squished by its Touchdown attack.
